rules.title: Fixture rule: blocked open without a version handler
detection_signals: Synthetic open call without a version change handler
rules.trigger: A synthetic upgrade runs while another tab still holds the old version.
rules.root_cause: The old tab never releases its handle, so the new open request stays blocked.
rules.how_to_spot: DevTools shows a pending request that never settles after an upgrade.
rules.fix: Close the handle on onversionchange so the upgrade can proceed.

rules.title: Fixture rule: layer value trapped in an isolated context
detection_signals: Synthetic layer value ignored inside an isolated parent
rules.trigger: A synthetic parent creates an isolated context around the child.
rules.root_cause: The child value only competes inside the isolated parent context.
rules.how_to_spot: The computed value is high but the element paints underneath a sibling.
rules.fix: Lift the child out of the isolated parent or isolate the sibling.
